# everpure_azure_reservations (Data Source)

Lists Reservations in a resource group, or across the provider's whole `subscription_id` when `resource_group_name` is omitted. The contact details a reservation was created with are personal data and are not returned.

To look up a single, already-known reservation, use the [`everpure_azure_reservation` data source](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/data-sources/reservation) instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

# Lists every reservation in one resource group.
data "everpure_azure_reservations" "example" {
  resource_group_name = "rg-storage-prod"
}

# Omit resource_group_name to list every reservation in the subscription.
data "everpure_azure_reservations" "all" {}

# Reservation IDs keyed by name, e.g. { "reservation-prod-east" = "/subscriptions/..." }.
output "reservation_ids" {
  value = {
    for reservation in data.everpure_azure_reservations.example.reservations :
    reservation.name => reservation.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `resource_group_name` (String) Resource group to list reservations in. Omitted to list every reservation in the provider's own `subscription_id`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `reservations` (Attributes List) The reservations found, sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reservations))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the reservations.


<a id="nestedatt--reservations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reservations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The full Azure Resource Manager ID of the reservation.
- `internal_id` (String) Everpure's internal ID of the reservation.
- `location` (String) Azure region the reservation was created in, using its canonical short name, e.g. `eastus2`.
- `marketplace_subscription_id` (String) ID of the Azure Marketplace subscription that bills for the reservation.
- `marketplace_subscription_status` (String) Status of the Azure Marketplace purchase: `PendingFulfillmentStart`, `Subscribed`, `Suspended` or `Unsubscribed`. The status can lag behind the purchase.
- `name` (String) Name of the reservation.
- `offer` (Attributes) The Azure Marketplace offer the reservation purchased, as the service reports it. Null when the service reports no offer for the reservation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reservations--offer))
- `resource_group_name` (String) Name of the resource group the reservation lives in.
- `tags` (Map of String) A mapping of tags assigned to the reservation.

<a id="nestedatt--reservations--offer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reservations.offer`

Read-Only:

- `offer_id` (String) ID of the Azure Marketplace offer.
- `plan_id` (String) ID of the offer's plan.
- `plan_name` (String) Display name of the plan, as the service reports it. It is not set by every offer.
- `term_unit` (String) Length of the plan's billing term as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. `P1M`.
